title: Tropical World
description: All-ocean overworld: a sunlit tropical sea of turquoise water and sandy islands with hidden oases. Built on Isekai API.
body:
**The overworld becomes a single sunlit tropical sea.** Turquoise water from horizon to horizon, scattered sand islets, and rare lush oases tucked among the islands. Powered by Isekai API.

## What it does

Tropical World turns the entire overworld into a warm, bright tropical ocean. Sea level rises and the surface reads as open turquoise water broken by sandy islands — a sunlit archipelago instead of continents. Vanilla biomes, ores, structures, and mobs still generate, so it plays like Minecraft, just at sea.

Hidden on the larger islands are **oases** — clear water pools ringed with grass, reeds, and clustered palms — placed as hand-authored set-pieces that only spawn on flat, dry ground (never half-sunk in the surf), via [Isekai API](https://modrinth.com/mod/isekai-api).

## Features

**All-ocean overworld** — turquoise tropical sea with sandy islets, not a continent in sight.

**Lush oases** — rare, coordinated water-and-palm set-pieces that sit cleanly on island interiors.

**Vanilla content preserved** — ores, structures, and mobs still generate; this is a reskin of where land is, not an empty water world.

## Requirements

**Isekai API is required** — Tropical World is a worldshape built entirely on Isekai's worldgen primitives.

## Compatibility

Coexists with TerraBlender, YUNG's structure mods, map mods (Journeymap etc.), and dimension mods. Mutually exclusive with other overworld-overhaul mods (Terralith, William Wythers') — only one mod can own the overworld; no crash, last-loaded wins.

## License & links

**Related projects**

- [Mountain World](https://modrinth.com/mod/mountain-world) — sister world: the overworld reforged as endless mountains
- [Sky World](https://modrinth.com/mod/sky-world) — sister world: the overworld as a vertical sea of floating islands
- [Tundra World](https://modrinth.com/mod/tundra-world) — sister world: the overworld frozen end to end
